purpose: Paired genuine Bazel 9.3.0 vs native bazel-rs capture of ignored directories (.bazelignore prefixes and REPO.bazel ignore_directories patterns). T: every CLI step of tests/ignored_directories.rs on byte-identical workspaces; P: probes of each Bazel behaviour claimed in docs/IGNORED_DIRECTORIES.md; N13: refresh of the N13 B/repo_ignore_directories_recursive scenarios. Evidence only; this file is not read by any test.

native.binary: target/debug/bazel-rs (rebuilt from the worktree before capture)
native.argv: --ignore_all_rc_files <cmd> <target> (exactly the test argv; default cache bazel-rs-out in the workspace)

environment: env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin LANG=C.UTF-8 LC_ALL=C.UTF-8 HOME/TMPDIR private, umask 022; paths normalized to <WS>/<OB>/<BASE>; scratch under /tmp/opencode removed=True

verdicts.EXACT: both succeed; query stdout identical (or built source paths in order, plus written bytes where recorded) and the ignored-directory WARNING lines agree (native WARNING lines appear verbatim in Bazel stderr and vice versa)
verdicts.EXACT_MESSAGE: both fail; native's primary error message appears verbatim in Bazel stderr
verdicts.MISMATCH: exit class differs, outputs/warnings differ, or both fail and the native message is absent from Bazel stderr (both recorded)

normalizations: absolute workspace/output-base paths -> <WS>/<OB>/<BASE> in both stderr/stdout before any comparison

reference build outputs: cquery --output=files <target> after the build (same output base and flags); external/<repo>+/<path> rewritten to <repo>/<path> (local_path_override path equals the module name); bazel-out/{stable,volatile}-status.txt dropped; built-source comparison ignores generated paths (bazel-out/..., native bazel-rs-out/...)
native build outputs: label<TAB>path lines with the <WS>/ prefix removed
display_form_only: native query stdout equals Bazel after {"@@ext+//": "@ext//", "@@+e+r//": "@r//"} (verdict stays MISMATCH)
